messages:
maria_cs: quick flag — Helios ramped ~1k users in staging and were seeing a concentrated 429 burst during the first 10-15m of sessions. They report most succeed after 1-2 retries. Can we triage?

clara_helios: theyre reproducing it in staging. Browser SDK v1.4.2, ephemeral tokens per tab (default). 429s line up with a lot of GET /v1/preflight calls and some POST /v1/chat/completions 429s.

aj-eng: likely preflight fanout + short ephemeral TTLs. Can you paste sanitized failing headers and say whether 429s are heavier on /preflight vs /v1/chat?

clara_helios: sample (sanitized):
POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.inference
Authorization: Bearer ephemeral_XYZ...
User-Agent: helios-web/1.4.2
X-Request-ID: 9a8b7c
Body: {"messages":[...], "max_tokens":256}
Status: 429 (retry-after: 1)

Also lots of GET /v1/preflight 429s at the same time.

sophie_se: this matches preflight stampede from many parallel tabs. Quick mitigations: cache preflight results client-side for 30-60s; reuse an ephemeral token across a session/window; and add jittered backoff.

aj-eng: add: exponential backoff with jitter (start ~300ms, cap ~5s) and avoid simultaneous immediate retries from all clients. Also ensure clients reuse HTTP/2 connections to reduce connect churn.

ben_oncall: we saw this with Ember last quarter. Short-term options: 1) temporary preflight quota bump for tenant H-427, 2) whitelist staging IPs for 1-2 hours, 3) advise staged rollout (10%->50%->100%). Want me to open the quota bump?

maria_cs: please open. Ill gather tenant id + staging IPs and schedule an enablement call in 30m.

clara_helios: tenant H-427. Staging egress: 54.23.12.8/32, 54.23.12.9/32. We can stagger if recommended.

aj-eng: longer-term recommendations: increase ephemeral TTL to 60s for onboarding, token pooling (one ephemeral per user for background requests), move heavy background prefetch to server-side proxies. We can also instrument client telemetry to detect duplicate preflights on tab restore.

sophie_se: Ill prep a short checklist for the call: reduce preflight frequency, enable http2 keepalive, add jittered backoff, reuse ephemeral tokens 30-60s, staged rollout. Code snippet for safe retry: \n// exponential backoff with jitter\nlet retry = 0;\nasync function send(req){\n  try{ return await fetch(req); }\n  catch(e){\n    if(retry++ > 5) throw e;\n    await sleep(Math.min(5000, 100 * 2**retry) * (0.5 + Math.random()/2));\n    return send(req);\n  }\n}\n

deploy-bot: notice: temp preflight throttle-relief queued (ticket CS-9831) — pending oncall approval.

ben_oncall: approved. Applying temporary bump to preflight window for H-427 now. Monitoring dashboards for retry storms.

maria_cs: great. Clara, on the call well walk the checklist and ask them to stage the ramp. After they stabilize well revert the bump. :thumbsup:

clara_helios: :thumbsup: joining in 10. Thanks for the quick turn.

aj-eng: diagnostic ask: can they snapshot client telemetry showing preflight timestamps + token issue timestamps? Client clock drift can cause duplicate preflights on tab restore. Please attach to ticket.

maria_cs: will collect and append to CS-9831. Well post a short outcome note here after the call with recommended defaults for future onboardings.

sophie_se: playbook note: recommend default browser ephemeral TTL 45-60s during initial ramp and include staged rollout + connection reuse in enablement checklist. Ill update the doc.

ben_oncall: monitoring update: already seeing ~30% drop in preflight 429s since bump. Will flag if retries spike again.

maria_cs: thanks team, closing thread for now — will reopen if issues persist.
